findings.issue: validateNarrowing remains in a JSDoc/comment invariant block (Инвариант I-2). Not user-facing rendered text — stays in a /* ... */ file header comment. Not a violation per design §D (only JSX render output is gated). Acceptable as developer docs.
findings.suggestion: If the comment is updated in a future pass, replace validateNarrowing with plain Russian. Not blocking.

findings.issue: JSON.stringify(result.data, null, 2) inside <pre> in ResultBanner.ok branch. This is a debug/success diagnostic dump for admin users (shows the raw API response after a successful intent), not a user-facing field value. Pre-existed on dev branch unchanged by this diff — not introduced by T-0532. Design §D exemption applies to API-body display; this is analogous. Acceptable.
findings.suggestion: Could be wrapped with formatJsonReadable in a future cleanup. Not blocking for this task.

findings.issue: formatDuration handles only simple single-unit patterns (PxxD, PTxxH, PTxxM). Combined durations like P1DT6H fall through to returning the raw ISO string. The design marks this as a bonus/followup (§E last row), so scope is correct — but the limitation is not documented in the function's JSDoc.
findings.suggestion: Add a note to the JSDoc: 'Note: only single-unit patterns supported; compound durations (P1DT6H) return the raw string.' Not blocking.

findings.issue: scopeDisplay fallback (else branch for unknown scope kinds) still uses JSON.stringify(s). This is a non-targeted site — not listed in the design's fitness table (§E) for this task. Pre-existed on dev. Out of T-0532 scope but worth a follow-up.
findings.suggestion: Replace with formatJsonReadable(s) in a follow-up task.

findings.issue: When value is a string not found in ENUM_LABELS or labelMap, formatEnum returns the raw value as-is. For machine enum values like 'service' or unknown future statuses this gives the correct fallback. However for truly unknown values it silently passes through in English. This is per-spec (design §A: 'Если нет в каталоге — value возвращается as-is'). No issue — just confirming spec-match.

acceptance_coverage.ac: format.js чистый — 5 функций без React/side-effects/сети, null-safe
